story_zh: 最近，我奶奶总是担心我的关系问题。昨天，我遇到热情的邻居阿姨，她关心地问我：“你愿意结婚吗？”我有点难过，因为最近没遇到合适的人。但阿姨说：“别害怕，越注意别人，越容易遇到可爱的人。”最后，她送我一个礼物，让我放心。
story_pinyin: Zuìjìn, wǒ nǎinai zǒngshì dānxīn wǒ de guānxì wèntí. Zuótiān, wǒ yùdào rèqíng de línjū āyí, tā guānxīn de wèn wǒ: “Nǐ yuànyì jiéhūn ma?” Wǒ yǒudiǎn nánguò, yīnwèi zuìjìn méi yùdào héshì de rén. Dàn āyí shuō: “Bié hàipà, yuè zhùyì biérén, yuè róngyì yùdào kě'ài de rén.” Zuìhòu, tā sòng wǒ yīgè lǐwù, ràng wǒ fàngxīn.
story_en: Recently, my grandmother has always been worried about my relationship issues. Yesterday, I met my enthusiastic neighbor aunt, who asked me caringly: "Are you willing to get married?" I felt a bit sad because I haven't met a suitable person recently. But the aunt said: "Don't be afraid, the more you pay attention to other people, the easier it is to meet lovely people." Finally, she gave me a gift to reassure me.
